current_difficulty_reason: The quoted class-index version of Minkowski does not provide a basis compatible with the skew-Hermitian form while keeping polynomial discriminant bounds. The authors extract small nondegenerate rank-one or rank-two modules, control the complementary lattice and repeat the construction through distinct field and quaternion cases with explicit index and pairing-size estimates. They also bound the failure of involution-stability of the stabilizer order to remove the extra induction parameter, a nonroutine quantitative arithmetic construction before the later formal applications.
